theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (s : ℝ), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖(ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x‖ ≤ s) → |S i ω| ≤ c * s) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun i => S i ω) atTop (𝓝 L)) → ∃ C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, WeaklyConvergesOn S C
